title: The Orchard's Final Count

features.name: the final fence-post
features.desc-on-touch: a numbered post at the orchard's edge—the last tree is behind you, the count has ended. the dream that continued without dreamers has learned to finish.

features.name: the numbered canopy
features.desc-on-touch: each tree has been marked with its count—row one: 1, 2, 3... the archive made of trees. when the last number is reached, the forest learns it is finite.

features.name: the tree where counting stopped
features.desc-on-touch: there is no post beyond this one. the dreamer stopped numbering here, leaving the rest of the forest unmeasured. the dream and the count diverged.

features.name: the ledger carved in bark
features.desc-on-touch: scratched into an old trunk: the tally marks of fifty years, some faded, some fresh. the dream has been keeping its own count all along.

features.name: the orchard s own sky-mirror
features.desc-on-touch: the canopy is so complete that the sky reflects only trees—the forest dreams of itself. the boundary between dream and counted orchard has become transparent.

inscription: the orchard learned to count itself, and the counting became the thing it was counting

file.name: Orchard_Census_1952_Present_Continuous.txt
file.note: tree tallies that never reached a final number, entries resuming each spring as if the count resets and continues

exits.label: back to the forest dream where numbering has not yet begun
to fields beyond the fence where trees become unmeasured
to the depths where the dream continues counting in the dark
